summary: Master Privacy Impact Assessments with our 5-day expert-led course. Learn ISO/IEC 29134, GDPR DPIA requirements, and Privacy by Design. Enroll today.
lede: Privacy impact assessments provide a structured way to identify and address privacy risks throughout a project or system’s lifecycle. This training is for professionals responsible for personal data and covers mapping data flows, analyzing privacy threats, designing mitigation measures, and reporting findings to stakeholders. It also addresses screening assessments, privacy-by-design considerations, and monitoring actions as systems change.
audienceIntro: This course is essential for professionals responsible for safeguarding personal data and ensuring organizational compliance with global privacy standards.
prerequisites: Participants should have a foundational understanding of privacy principles or at least one year of experience in compliance, IT security, or legal roles. Familiarity with the basic requirements of the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) or similar regional data protection laws is recommended but not mandatory. No prior experience with specific privacy software is required as the course focuses on methodology and framework application.
